tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You are a student who recently received a grade for a term paper. You want to discuss the grade with your professor, Dr. Williams. Write an email to Dr. Williams.
bullets: Explain why you are concerned about the grade you received.
Request guidance on how to improve in future assignments.
Suggest ways to make up for the low grade.
tasks.subject: Concern about term paper grade
